description: Report a domain's popularity on the Tranco research list (keyless): its rank in the top ~1M sites, a band (top-1k/10k/100k/1M or 'unranked'), and how many recent daily lists it appears in. A cheap context signal — a top-1k domain and an unranked one warrant very different scrutiny, and an unexpectedly unranked lookalike is a phishing tell. Reads Tranco's database, never the target. Read-only.
name: tranco_rank
